dct_description_sm: Population Raster Nauru 2020 Data Input: Household locations from 2019 Population and Housing Census conducted using Survey Solutions CAPI (Computer Assisted Personal Interview). Year Population Growth Rate of 0.8% has been applied to update population up to 2020 Household locations vector layer has been transformed into a 100m resolution raster. _Access this dataset from the [Pacific Data Hub](https://pacificdata.org/data/dataset/nru_population_grid_2020)_
